title: Johnny Mathis Those Were The Days 8-Track Tape, Epic Records
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 8-Track Tape of Johnny Mathis' album "Those Were The Days," released by Epic. This collectible music format allows listeners to enjoy the music of the iconic artist in a unique retro way. Perfect for music enthusiasts who appreciate the nostalgia and authenticity of vintage music recordings.
